newsitem.title: USA: Wells-Gardner gets order from Silicon Gaming.
newsitem.headline: Wells-Gardner gets order from Silicon Gaming.

text.p: Wells-Gardner Electronics Corp said Monday it received an order for 880 video monitors from Silicon Gaming of California.
A Wells-Gardner spokesman said the order, valued at between $300,000 and $440,000, was the company's first from Silicon Gaming. Silicon Gaming will use the monitors for its games for casinos.

"Silicon Gaming produces some of the most innovative gaming products available in the global gaming industry today," Anthony Spier, chairman, said in a statement. "We are very proud to have been selected as a key supplier to Silicon Gaming."
